raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":2907,"db":"POSTGRESQL","query":"SELECT mmsi, ROUND(AVG(sog), 2) AS avg_sog FROM public.vessel_ais_data WHERE timestamp::date = CURRENT_DATE AND ST_Within(geom, ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON((120.9167 35.8333, 121.1667 35.8333, 121.1667 35.5833, 120.9167 35.5833, 120.9167 35.8333))', 4326)) GROUP BY mmsi"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"查询今天出现在青岛朝连岛附近水域禁航区的船舶","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["mmsi","timestamp","geom"]},{"requirement":"输出船舶MMSI","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["mmsi"]},{"requirement":"输出平均航速","tables":["POSTGRESQL:public.vessel_ais_data"],"columns":["sog"]}],"assumptions":["青岛朝连岛附近水域禁航区无精确边界定义，采用近似矩形范围：经度120.9167至121.1667，纬度35.5833至35.8333（基于训练案例中朝连岛禁航区多边形坐标推断）","平均航速按每艘船舶今日在禁航区内所有AIS记录的平均SOG计算，保留两位小数"]}
